g.text: Auth0 login to Azure Blob Storage with Workload Identity Federation
2. Exchange the token for an Entra access token
Entra refuses this request with a browser Origin header (AADSTS9002326),
so the Worker repeats it server-side. Pass-through only: no secrets, no state.
Federated credential on the app registration checks:
1. signature, and iss equals the credential's issuer
2. aud equals the credential's single audience (api://AzureADTokenExchange)
(rejects ID tokens and tokens for other APIs)
3. sub equals the credential's subject exactly (one credential per user, no wildcards)
3. Use Blob Storage with the Entra token
The app's service principal holds "Storage Blob Data Contributor" on the container.
Every user with a federated credential acts as that one principal, so, as on GCP,
there is no per-user prefix isolation.
